summary: GeoPark Limited filed a Form 6-K on October 16, 2026 announcing a concurrent private placement of new 144A/Reg S senior notes and a cash tender offer for any and all of its outstanding 8.750% senior notes due 2030. Proceeds fund repurchase of tendered 2030 notes, repayment or redemption of 5.500% senior notes due 2027, and Vaca Muerta development capex over 18 months. Pricing and terms remain subject to market conditions; no board recommendation or advisor is named. Structurally, the offering and tender are conditioned on each other, creating refinancing execution risk and potential 2030 note overhang; watch pricing, participation and the 2027 maturity resolution.
